cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Make It Their Idea
cards.instruction: Make an unwanted task sound appealing enough that someone volunteers for it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You put those chess pieces in separate trays so confidently. Sorting the club cupboard could be your chance to choose the best set for yourself.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: These are biscuits. The chess sets are in the black cases.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Of course. Refreshments first. You could choose a black case once you've sorted the others.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The cases are identical. I'd do it if I could choose who I play next week.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally, choose the opponent, not the case. You sort the cupboard and name your opponent; I'll take whoever's left.

reason: Replace removable confidence wrappers with an explicit copied cue, revealed misunderstanding and face-saving continuation of the same Drive pursuit.
